answer: Proof of unique U2F counter monotonicity turns identity into something scarce. Because a security-key counter that only ever moved forward, the opal of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a security-key counter that only ever moved forward is something they already have; the oasis falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A farm doing the maths finds the ferrous first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
